rules.title: Immutable data
rules.text: Prefer immutable case classes and collections.

rules.title: Option instead of null
rules.text: Use Option, Either and Try instead of null and exceptions for control flow.

rules.title: One effect system
rules.text: Use the project effect system (cats-effect, ZIO or Futures) consistently.

rules.title: Limit implicits
rules.text: Keep implicits and givens explicit and discoverable.
